paper_metadata.title: PROPERTIES OF SHEETS FROM HIGH-PROCESSIBILITY ALLOY V1341

evidence.quote: Alloy V1341 (of type A V) belongs to the class of heat-hardenable low-alloy alloys based on the Al – Mg – Si system [1, 2].
The obtained level of properties of al - loy V1341T1 exceeds substantially the level of properties of alloys of the magnalium group recommended for operation at up to 200°C.

The properties were determined for cold-rolled sheets with a thickness of 1.5 – 2.5 mm, which were fabricated from alloy V1341T1 bearing 0.83 – 1.2% Si, 0.6 – 0.77% Mg, and 0.30 – 0.44% Cu, in state T1 (heating for hardening to 530°C in a saltpeter tank, 5-min hold, water cooling + arti- ficial aging at 170°C for 14 h).
Sheets from alloy V1341T1 are compared with sheets from alloy AMg6M used for articles serving at medium loads.
